statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk is low at 12 while Stress stays elevated at 47.
recommendation: Tail sits well below the block threshold, so the mapped state is EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The decisive evidence is that Wednesday's gap-down was fully retraced, NDX closed within ten points of its session high, and both the 10-year and 30-year yields finished at the low end of their day ranges after multi-decade-high prints. Stress stays elevated on unresolved long-end duration, Brent above $101 and a narrow tape. The one named caution window is Thursday's 17:00-19:00 UTC block containing the 30-year bond auction and the Musalem speech, where a duration-driven second leg is the main conditional risk.
headline: NDX settles 31,160.08 near its session high and yields close at day-range lows; NQ futures in the CME maintenance break
body: The Nasdaq-100 closed at 31,160.08, down 64.61 points or 0.21% against Tuesday's 31,224.69 close, and the cash session has now been shut for more than an hour. The path remains more informative than the level: the index gapped down to open at 30,976.25, fell to 30,904.46, recovered the entire decline to print a 31,170.12 session high and settled within ten points of it. A completed retracement of that size that finishes at the top of the range is the opposite of the persistent no-retracement structure Tail measures, which is why Tail eases a further point to 12. Two fresh confirmations arrived with the final prints. The 10-year yield closed at 5.28% at the very bottom of a 5.27-5.36% day range after touching its highest level since April 2002, and the 30-year closed at 5.66% against a 5.73% high, its highest since May 2002. Yields finishing at their session lows after multi-decade-high prints is orderly price discovery, not a duration spiral. Volatility decayed in parallel: VIX settled 15.08 after a 16.01 session high, near the low of its 14.97-16.01 range. This clock hour is structurally quiet. NQ December futures last printed 31,403.75, down 0.25%, having recovered from a 31,144.50 session low, and the contract is now inside the CME daily maintenance break that runs to roughly 22:00 UTC, so no price discovery is available in this slot. That is a scheduled liquidity gap rather than an evidence failure, and Confidence is held at 88 because every other input used here is current and verified: cash closes, VIX, the 2-year at 4.79% alongside the 10-year and 30-year, Brent, and the seven-day calendar. Stress stays elevated at 47 because the difficult-environment inputs are unresolved rather than because the price path is pathological. Long-end duration remains stressed, Brent is back above $101 and WTI near $90 after renewed Strait of Hormuz attacks and a Gulf storm threat, and Wednesday's recovery was narrow: the Russell 2000 fell 1.31% and the Dow 0.66% against a 0.22% decline in both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite, while gold slipped 1.2% and bitcoin fell about 2.7% to roughly $83,300. The September 15-16 FOMC minutes, released Wednesday, recorded a unanimous 12-0 vote for the quarter-point increase to a 3-3/4 to 4 percent range, with most participants judging another increase likely appropriate by year end; that keeps the policy path live without having produced one-way equity structure. The shared Finviz context file was read at the start of this run and is not usable: its collection timestamp is 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z, roughly eight days stale, with a partial collection status. Per the provider-neutral evidence contract that failure is isolated and this assessment rests entirely on independent primary-source research. Looking forward, the named caution block is 17:00-19:00 UTC on 8 October, covering the 30-year bond auction and the 17:40 UTC Musalem speech. A weak long-end auction into a 5.66% 30-year, followed by hawkish remarks, is the most credible two-stage mechanism for a duration-driven leg that denies retracement, so forecast Tail is lifted to 22 and then 20 in the watch band across those two hours. Everything outside that window stays in the low band, and no future price structure is presented as already observed.

outlookSummary: The near-term path is treated as conditionally two-way. Risk eases from the current 12 to an 11 floor across the futures reopen and the Asian hours, since thin but orderly overnight trade normally still permits retracement. It then rebuilds through the European morning, the 08:30 UTC Waller speech, the 12:30 UTC jobless-claims release and the 13:30 UTC US cash open, where Tail reaches the 19 low-band ceiling. The one named caution block is 17:00-19:00 UTC on 8 October, covering the 30-year bond auction and the 17:40 UTC Musalem speech, where Tail is lifted to 22 and then 20 in the watch band because a weak long-end auction into a 5.66% 30-year is the most credible duration-driven one-way mechanism. Tail returns to 17 in the closing hour. Every forecast hour beyond the current slot frames price structure conditionally; no future one-way path is treated as already observed.
